# Research Context

## Botanical archives as visual systems {.smaller}

- Botanical knowledge historically circulated through **image–text assemblages**
- Illustrations functioned as tools of:
  - taxonomy
  - classification
  - imperial knowledge-making
- European botanical illustration emphasised:
  - standardisation
  - morphological comparison
  - isolated specimens
- Parallel traditions also existed:
  - Chinese *Bencao*
  - Japanese illustrated herbals
  - medicinal manuscripts

::: {.notes}
Emphasise that this project is not only technical, but also historical and epistemological.
:::

---

# Project Aim

## What is *Phyto-Vision*?

Phyto-Vision is a reproducible computational workflow for:

- metadata normalisation
- archival deduplication
- automated botanical illustration extraction
- visual similarity analysis

## Goal

Transform heterogeneous digitised botanical pages into a structured, machine-readable visual corpus.

# Metadata and Deduplication

## Building interoperable archives

- Metadata schema adapted from the *ZuantuSet* workflow
- Descriptive fields normalised into machine-readable formats
- Duplicate editions identified through image collation techniques
- Supports:
  - longitudinal comparison
  - cross-cultural analysis
  - scalable archival integration

---

# Iconographic Extraction

## YOLOv11 object detection

- Seed corpus:
  - 781 manually annotated illustrations
- Sources included:
  - Library of Congress
  - Bibliothèque nationale de France
  - Royal Horticultural Society
  - National Archives of Japan
  - University of Tokyo Library

## Data augmentation

- horizontal flipping
- random cropping
- noise injection

Expanded training set:
**1,875 images**

# Model Performance

## Round 1 Training Results

- mAP@50: **96.9%**
- Precision: **95.5%**
- Recall: **90.3%**

## Iterative refinement

- Applied model to 391 additional pages
- Manual correction of predictions
- Added hard negative samples
- Expanded dataset to:
  - **2,815 images**

# Visual Embedding Analysis

## Beyond detection

After extraction:

- Illustrations converted into embeddings using:
  - **DINOv2 ViT-B/14**
- Similarity measured using:
  - cosine similarity
- Clustering performed with:
  - HDBSCAN

## Enables

- similarity retrieval
- visual grouping
- cross-cultural comparison
- unsupervised pattern discovery

```{=html}
<div id="umap-viz">
  <canvas id="umap-canvas"></canvas>
  <button id="umap-reset" type="button">Reset view</button>
  <div id="umap-legend"></div>
  <div id="umap-tooltip"></div>
  <div id="umap-hint">hover&nbsp;·&nbsp;click to zoom in&nbsp;·&nbsp;drag to pan&nbsp;·&nbsp;scroll to zoom&nbsp;·&nbsp;click legend to toggle</div>
  <div id="umap-error"></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const container = document.getElementById('umap-viz');
  const canvas = document.getElementById('umap-canvas');
  const tooltip = document.getElementById('umap-tooltip');
  const legendEl = document.getElementById('umap-legend');
  const resetBtn = document.getElementById('umap-reset');
  const errorEl = document.getElementById('umap-error');
  if (!container || !canvas || container.dataset.bound) return;
  container.dataset.bound = '1';

  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let data = null;
  const thumbs = new Map();
  let camera = { x: 0.5, y: 0.5, zoom: 1 };
  let dataBox = { x0: 0, y0: 0, x1: 1, y1: 1 };
  let scheduled = false;
  let initialised = false;
  let hoveredIdx = -1;
  const hiddenClusters = new Set();
  let animFrame = null;

  function defaultCamera() {
    return {
      x: (dataBox.x0 + dataBox.x1) / 2,
      y: (dataBox.y0 + dataBox.y1) / 2,
      zoom: 1,
    };
  }

  function fitCameraToData() { Object.assign(camera, defaultCamera()); }

  function requestDraw() {
    if (scheduled) return;
    scheduled = true;
    requestAnimationFrame(() => { scheduled = false; draw(); });
  }

  function resize() {
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0) return;
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    canvas.width = Math.round(r.width * dpr);
    canvas.height = Math.round(r.height * dpr);
    canvas.style.width = r.width + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = r.height + 'px';
    ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
    requestDraw();
  }

  function worldToScreen(wx, wy, r) {
    const sx = (r.width  * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.x1 - dataBox.x0);
    const sy = (r.height * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.y1 - dataBox.y0);
    return [r.width  / 2 + (wx - camera.x) * sx,
            r.height / 2 + (wy - camera.y) * sy];
  }

  function currentThumbPx() {
    return Math.max(28, Math.min(120, 42 * Math.sqrt(camera.zoom)));
  }

  function currentDotR() {
    return Math.max(1.0, 1.4 * Math.sqrt(camera.zoom));
  }

  function draw() {
    if (!data) return;
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (r.width === 0 || r.height === 0) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0d1117';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, r.width, r.height);

    const dotR = currentDotR();
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.nodes.length; i++) {
      const n = data.nodes[i];
      if (hiddenClusters.has(n.c)) continue;
      if (n.img && thumbs.has(i)) continue;
      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y, r);
      if (sx < -4 || sx > r.width + 4 || sy < -4 || sy > r.height + 4) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = data.colors[n.c];
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(sx, sy, dotR, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1;

    const thumbPx = currentThumbPx();
    for (const [i, img] of thumbs) {
      const n = data.nodes[i];
      if (hiddenClusters.has(n.c)) continue;
      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y, r);
      if (sx < -thumbPx || sx > r.width + thumbPx ||
          sy < -thumbPx || sy > r.height + thumbPx) continue;
      const aspect = (img.naturalWidth && img.naturalHeight)
        ? img.naturalWidth / img.naturalHeight : 1;
      let w, h;
      if (aspect >= 1) { w = thumbPx; h = thumbPx / aspect; }
      else { h = thumbPx; w = thumbPx * aspect; }
      ctx.fillStyle = data.colors[n.c];
      ctx.fillRect(sx - w / 2 - 2, sy - h / 2 - 2, w + 4, h + 4);
      ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
      ctx.fillRect(sx - w / 2 - 1, sy - h / 2 - 1, w + 2, h + 2);
      try { ctx.drawImage(img, sx - w / 2, sy - h / 2, w, h); } catch (e) {}
    }

    if (hoveredIdx >= 0) {
      const n = data.nodes[hoveredIdx];
      if (!hiddenClusters.has(n.c)) {
        const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y, r);
        const isThumb = n.img && thumbs.has(hoveredIdx);
        const radius = isThumb ? thumbPx * 0.66 : Math.max(7, dotR * 4);
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#ffffff';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx, sy, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.strokeStyle = data.colors[n.c];
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.arc(sx, sy, radius + 4, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.stroke();
      }
    }
  }

  function hitTest(mx, my) {
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const dotR = currentDotR();
    const thumbPx = currentThumbPx();
    let best = -1, bestD = Infinity;
    const maxHit = 22;
    for (let i = 0; i < data.nodes.length; i++) {
      const n = data.nodes[i];
      if (hiddenClusters.has(n.c)) continue;
      const [sx, sy] = worldToScreen(n.x, n.y, r);
      if (sx < -thumbPx || sx > r.width + thumbPx ||
          sy < -thumbPx || sy > r.height + thumbPx) continue;
      const limit = (n.img && thumbs.has(i)) ? thumbPx * 0.55 : Math.max(6, dotR * 3.5);
      const dx = sx - mx, dy = sy - my;
      const d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
      if (d2 < limit * limit && d2 < maxHit * maxHit && d2 < bestD) {
        bestD = d2;
        best = i;
      }
    }
    return best;
  }

  function animateCamera(target, duration) {
    duration = duration || 450;
    const from = { x: camera.x, y: camera.y, zoom: camera.zoom };
    const start = performance.now();
    if (animFrame) cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame);
    const ease = (t) => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);
    const step = (now) => {
      const t = Math.min(1, (now - start) / duration);
      const e = ease(t);
      camera.x    = from.x    + (target.x    - from.x   ) * e;
      camera.y    = from.y    + (target.y    - from.y   ) * e;
      camera.zoom = from.zoom + (target.zoom - from.zoom) * e;
      draw();
      if (t < 1) animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
      else animFrame = null;
    };
    animFrame = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }

  function showTooltip(idx, clientX, clientY) {
    const n = data.nodes[idx];
    const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
    const localX = clientX - r.left;
    const localY = clientY - r.top;
    const cluster = String(n.c).padStart(2, '0');
    const colour = data.colors[n.c];
    const imgHtml = n.img ? '<img src="' + n.img + '" alt="">' : '';
    tooltip.innerHTML =
      imgHtml +
      '<div class="tip-meta">' +
      '<span class="tip-dot" style="background:' + colour + '"></span>' +
      'Cluster ' + cluster + '</div>';
    tooltip.style.display = 'block';
    const tw = tooltip.offsetWidth  || 230;
    const th = tooltip.offsetHeight || 240;
    let tx = localX + 18, ty = localY + 18;
    if (tx + tw > r.width  - 110) tx = localX - tw - 12;
    if (ty + th > r.height - 8)   ty = localY - th - 12;
    tooltip.style.left = Math.max(4, tx) + 'px';
    tooltip.style.top  = Math.max(4, ty) + 'px';
  }

  function hideTooltip() { tooltip.style.display = 'none'; }

  function buildLegend() {
    const items = data.colors.map((c, i) => {
      const count = (data.cluster_counts && data.cluster_counts[i]) || 0;
      return '<div class="lg-item" data-cluster="' + i + '">' +
        '<div class="lg-dot" style="background:' + c + '"></div>' +
        '<div class="lg-num">' + String(i).padStart(2, '0') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="lg-cnt">' + count + '</div>' +
        '</div>';
    }).join('');
    legendEl.innerHTML =
      '<div class="lg-title">Clusters &middot; k=' + data.k + '</div>' +
      '<div class="lg-actions">' +
        '<button data-act="all">All</button>' +
        '<button data-act="none">None</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      items;
    legendEl.querySelectorAll('.lg-item').forEach((el) => {
      el.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        const c = parseInt(el.dataset.cluster, 10);
        if (hiddenClusters.has(c)) hiddenClusters.delete(c);
        else hiddenClusters.add(c);
        el.classList.toggle('lg-off', hiddenClusters.has(c));
        if (hoveredIdx >= 0 && hiddenClusters.has(data.nodes[hoveredIdx].c)) {
          hoveredIdx = -1; hideTooltip();
        }
        requestDraw();
      });
    });
    legendEl.querySelectorAll('.lg-actions button').forEach((btn) => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (btn.dataset.act === 'all') hiddenClusters.clear();
        else for (let i = 0; i < data.k; i++) hiddenClusters.add(i);
        legendEl.querySelectorAll('.lg-item').forEach((el) => {
          const c = parseInt(el.dataset.cluster, 10);
          el.classList.toggle('lg-off', hiddenClusters.has(c));
        });
        hoveredIdx = -1; hideTooltip();
        requestDraw();
      });
    });
  }

  function bindInteractions() {
    let dragging = false, lastX = 0, lastY = 0, dragMoved = false;
    const insideChrome = (target) => !!target.closest('#umap-legend, #umap-reset, #umap-tooltip');

    container.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
      if (insideChrome(e.target)) return;
      if (animFrame) { cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame); animFrame = null; }
      dragging = true; dragMoved = false;
      lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
      container.classList.add('dragging');
    });
    window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
      dragging = false;
      container.classList.remove('dragging');
    });
    window.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
      const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (dragging) {
        dragMoved = true;
        const sx = (r.width  * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.x1 - dataBox.x0);
        const sy = (r.height * camera.zoom) / Math.max(1e-6, dataBox.y1 - dataBox.y0);
        camera.x -= (e.clientX - lastX) / sx;
        camera.y -= (e.clientY - lastY) / sy;
        lastX = e.clientX; lastY = e.clientY;
        hideTooltip();
        if (hoveredIdx !== -1) { hoveredIdx = -1; }
        requestDraw();
        return;
      }
      if (e.clientX < r.left || e.clientX > r.right ||
          e.clientY < r.top  || e.clientY > r.bottom ||
          insideChrome(e.target)) {
        if (hoveredIdx !== -1) { hoveredIdx = -1; hideTooltip(); requestDraw(); }
        container.classList.remove('hovering');
        return;
      }
      const idx = hitTest(e.clientX - r.left, e.clientY - r.top);
      if (idx !== hoveredIdx) {
        hoveredIdx = idx;
        requestDraw();
      }
      if (idx >= 0) {
        showTooltip(idx, e.clientX, e.clientY);
        container.classList.add('hovering');
      } else {
        hideTooltip();
        container.classList.remove('hovering');
      }
    });
    container.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
      if (hoveredIdx !== -1) hoveredIdx = -1;
      hideTooltip();
      container.classList.remove('hovering');
      requestDraw();
    });

    container.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      if (insideChrome(e.target)) return;
      if (dragMoved) return;
      if (hoveredIdx < 0) return;
      const n = data.nodes[hoveredIdx];
      animateCamera({
        x: n.x,
        y: n.y,
        zoom: Math.min(80, camera.zoom * 2.4),
      });
    });

    container.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
      e.preventDefault();
      if (animFrame) { cancelAnimationFrame(animFrame); animFrame = null; }
      const factor = Math.exp(-e.deltaY * 0.0015);
      const r = container.getBoundingClientRect();
      const mx = (e.clientX - r.left) / r.width;
      const my = (e.clientY - r.top) / r.height;
      const wx = camera.x + (mx - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      const wy = camera.y + (my - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      camera.zoom = Math.max(0.5, Math.min(80, camera.zoom * factor));
      camera.x = wx - (mx - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      camera.y = wy - (my - 0.5) / camera.zoom;
      requestDraw();
    }, { passive: false });

    resetBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      animateCamera(defaultCamera(), 600);
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
  }

  async function init() {
    if (initialised) { resize(); return; }
    initialised = true;
    try {
      const res = await fetch('umap_data.json');
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
      data = await res.json();
    } catch (e) {
      errorEl.style.display = 'flex';
      errorEl.innerHTML =
        'Could not load umap_data.json &mdash; serve the slides via a ' +
        'local web server (e.g. <code>quarto preview</code>).';
      return;
    }

    let x0 = Infinity, y0 = Infinity, x1 = -Infinity, y1 = -Infinity;
    for (const n of data.nodes) {
      if (n.x < x0) x0 = n.x;
      if (n.y < y0) y0 = n.y;
      if (n.x > x1) x1 = n.x;
      if (n.y > y1) y1 = n.y;
    }
    dataBox = { x0, y0, x1, y1 };
    fitCameraToData();

    buildLegend();
    resize();
    requestDraw();

    const queue = [];
    data.nodes.forEach((n, i) => { if (n.img) queue.push([i, n.img]); });
    const MAX_PARALLEL = 8;
    let inflight = 0, cursor = 0;
    function pump() {
      while (inflight < MAX_PARALLEL && cursor < queue.length) {
        const [idx, url] = queue[cursor++];
        inflight++;
        const im = new Image();
        im.onload = () => { thumbs.set(idx, im); inflight--; requestDraw(); pump(); };
        im.onerror = () => { inflight--; pump(); };
        im.src = url;
      }
    }
    pump();

    bindInteractions();
  }

  const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    for (const e of entries) {
      if (e.isIntersecting && e.intersectionRatio > 0) {
        init();
        io.disconnect();
        break;
      }
    }
  }, { threshold: 0.01 });
  io.observe(container);

  if (typeof Reveal !== 'undefined' && Reveal.on) {
    Reveal.on('slidechanged', () => setTimeout(() => { if (initialised) resize(); }, 40));
    Reveal.on('resize', () => { if (initialised) resize(); });
  }
})();
</script>
```

# Results and Interpretation

## What becomes possible?

Phyto-Vision enables large-scale analysis of:

- visual standardisation
- page composition
- illustration conventions
- cross-cultural botanical representation

## Key idea

Historical visual logics become computationally analysable.

# Contribution

## Digital Plant Humanities

Phyto-Vision contributes:

- a reproducible workflow
- computational access to botanical iconography
- scalable cross-archive comparison
- integration of computer vision with historical inquiry

## Broader significance

The project connects:

- computer vision
- archival studies
- history of botany

# Conclusion

## Phyto-Vision

- combines archival methods with AI-based image analysis
- transforms historical botanical pages into structured visual data
- supports longitudinal and cross-cultural analysis
- provides an Open Access computational framework for botanical archives
